verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a web and app payments service like Wise Business, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookie or tracking controls, or any opt-out mechanism. The docs cover payments, cards, accounts and webhooks only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
